extraction.Name: Rosa Dubray
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by Todd County State Bank
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Todd County State Bank April 15, 1920 for $300; mortgaged May 28, 1920 to the Todd County State Bank for $1368; another mortgage by Rosa Dubray now Rosa Iron Shell and husband to Clano Realty Company for $300; on August 17, 1920, Rosa Dubray Iron Shell and husband conveyed by deed to E. R. Rusho for $3500
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739609 issued; Southeast quarter section 32, township 38, north of range 26; receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee April 2, 1920; Agent's contract to sell dated May 18, 1920, between Rosa Dubray and Clanco Realty Company shows that the company was to have all over $4000 for which land was sold; mortgaged by Rosa Dubray to Todd County State Bank April 15, 1920 for $300; also mortgaged May 28, 1920 to Todd County State Bank for $1368; mortgage by Rosa Dubray now Rosa Iron Shell and husband dated June 12, 1920 to Clano Realty Company for $300; Rosa Dubray also signed a mortgage to Rosalie Dubray to the Todd County State Bank May 5, 1920 for $300; Rosa Dubray Iron Shell and husband conveyed by deed to E. R. Rusho for $3500 on August 17, 1920
